title: Easy Trashcan
description: Inventory clogged with garbage?This is the trash can you need.  Get rid of all that junk and reclaim your space!
body:
**Don't let inventory clutter ruin your blocky paradise! Introducing the "Disposable Trash Can" Datapack!**

This datapack adds a convenient, temporary trash can to your game! Just activate the trashcan trigger using `/trigger trashcan` to summon a chest minecart called "Trash Can". Dump all your unwanted cobblestone, bones, and other building materials inside.After a short timer, the can and its contents vanish entirely (with a *poof* sound), freeing up your valuable inventory space.

**Features:**

*   **Easy to use:** Type `/trigger trashcan` to create the trash can.
*   **Automatic Disposal:** The trash can and its contents disappear after a short delay.
*   **Clean Environment:** No more lingering trash piles!

**Clean up your inventory today with the Easy Trash Can Datapack!**
